title: CYBRIK org external exchange v1 (D-6)
description: A typed, contract-bound exchange with an EXTERNAL authority (e.g. A05) across a trust boundary (ADR-0007 D-6; 02 §4; INV-2). The external peer is never a parent/ancestor, never an org_node member, and never a super-admin: external_peer.boundary_kind is const 'external', and its authorization is a DISTINCT trust context (auth_context const 'external-distinct') that NEVER reuses an internal user/service token (OD-3) — additionalProperties:false makes an internal_service_token / bearer field structurally impossible. Direction is explicit: 'outbound-submission' vs 'inbound-directive'. An inbound directive NEVER auto-executes (auto_execute const false); it enters the normal policy/approval/tool review path. Every crossing is marked, residency-checked (deny-by-default, OD-4), minimized, and audited. The transport floor is mTLS + signed envelope + audience/nonce/timestamp/replay protection (OD-5). $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

external_peer.description: The external authority peer. boundary_kind is const 'external' — an internal node can never be the peer of an external exchange, and the external peer is never an internal ancestor/member (INV-2).

tenant_id.description: Our (internal) tenant on this side of the crossing.

authorization.description: The DISTINCT external-exchange authorization context (OD-3). It is NOT an internal user/service JWT/SSO token and reuses no internal credential. additionalProperties:false: there is nowhere for an internal_service_token / bearer / on_behalf_of_user_token to live.

auth_context.description: Const 'external-distinct': this authorization is a distinct trust context, never an internal token (OD-3).

audience.description: The external peer this authorization is bound to (confused-deputy defense; audience set to the external peer).

purpose.description: The bounded purpose of this exchange.

mtls.description: Const true: mutually-authenticated transport is the floor (OD-5). Hardware-backed keys preferred/required where supported.

signed_envelope.description: Const true: a signed envelope with audience/nonce/timestamp is required (OD-5).

replay_protection.description: Const true: nonce/timestamp replay protection + key rotation/revocation (OD-5).

marking.description: Authoritative marking of the exchanged data. Marking is enforced on the crossing and is NEVER downgraded relative to the source (runtime); TLP:AMBER+STRICT / TLP:RED + residency caveats can block a crossing outright.

jurisdiction.description: Residency policy for this crossing, evaluated deny-by-default (OD-4). The peer's residency_zone MUST be in allowed_zones or the crossing is denied.

minimization.description: Minimization: share the least (02 §4). Prefer an aggregate or a single delegated object over a raw dump.

mode.description: 'aggregate' = de-identified roll-up; 'delegated-object' = one specific shared object; 'minimized-record' = a reduced record. There is no 'raw-dump' mode.

object_ref.description: For delegated-object / minimized-record: the specific shared object, digest-bound.

auto_execute.description: Const false: an inbound directive from an external authority NEVER auto-executes; it enters the normal policy/approval/tool path like any other request (02 §4; INV-2).

review_queue_ref.description: For inbound-directive: the review-queue entry the directive lands in (it does not auto-execute). Required for inbound directives.

temporal.description: Per-exchange authorization is time-bounded, revocable, audited (audit_ref required).

allOf.$comment: An inbound directive must land in a review queue (it never auto-executes).
